description: PostgresVersionUpgrade is the Schema for the postgresversionupgrades API

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: PostgresVersionUpgradeSpec defines the desired state of PostgresVersionUpgrade

omitBackup.description: OmitBackup provides the option to opt out of backup when performing major version upgrades

postgresInstance.description: PostgresInstance references the target instance which should be upgraded

name.description:
Name of the referent.
This field is effectively required, but due to backwards compatibility is
allowed to be empty. Instances of this type with an empty value here are
almost certainly wrong.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

postgresVersion.description: PostgresVersion references the version to upgrade the target instance to

versionJobUpgradeStorageClassName.description:
VersionUpgradeJobStorageClassName describes StorageClass to use for dynamically provisioning Persistent Volumes for postgres binary
(PVs) for a Postgres Binary for Version Upgrade Job

versionPreUpgradeJobStorageClassName.description:
VersionPreUpgradeJobStorageClassName describes StorageClass to use for dynamically provisioning Persistent Volumes for postgres binary
(PVs) for a Postgres Binary for Version PreUpgrade Job

status.description: PostgresVersionUpgradeStatus defines the observed state of PostgresVersionUpgrade

desiredHighAvailabilityConfig.description: DesiredHighAvailabilityConfig is an internal state field that indicates the final HA configuration

enabled.description:
Enabled specifies whether the Postgres instance is created in a single or cluster mode configuration.
By default, false is used

podDisruptionBudget.description: PodDisruptionBudget holds the settings related to Pod Disruption Budget

enabled.description: Enabled specifies whether the Pod Disruption Budget should be enabled for the instance

readReplicas.description: ReadReplicas specifies the number of read replicas to create when HA mode is enabled

message.description: Message provides details about the current status of the PostgresVersionUpgrade.

phase.description: Phase indicates the status of the upgrade.

preCheckErrors.description: PreCheckErrors provides details about the precheck errors for the given the PostgresVersionUpgrade.

preCheckStatus.description: PreCheckStatus provides details about the precheck status of the PostgresVersionUpgrade.

timeCompleted.description: TimeCompleted indicates the time that this PostgresVersionUpgrade completed or failed.

timeStarted.description: TimeStarted indicates the time that this PostgresVersionUpgrade was started.
